body_md:
Five independently owned roofing contractors in Tallahassee are listed here, each with a named owner and a Florida DBPR Certified Roofing Contractor license recorded as Current, Active. Every license expires 08/31/2028, and every listing has a Tallahassee address. Compare the stated service areas, services, and hours below, then confirm details on the linked sources.

## How we picked

Each company was checked in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup for license type, number, status, and expiration. Named owner, Tallahassee location, and stated service area were recorded with those license facts. Services, hours, certifications, warranties, and financing are included only when supplied. Each listing links to its DBPR license-detail source. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-04. Prices are unknown for all five, so none are shown.

## At a glance

- Licenses, all Current, Active, expiring 08/31/2028: Smith Roofing and Repair Inc. CCC1326753; Hartsfield Roofing & Construction, LLC CCC1329336; Coastal Roofing Solutions, LLC CCC1336010; Rare Breed Roofing, LLC CCC1331660; Arnold's Roofing Enterprises, Inc. CCC058324.
- Stated service areas: Smith Roofing and Repair — Tallahassee and north Florida; Hartsfield — Tallahassee, Bradfordville, Crawfordville, and surrounding North Florida; Coastal Roofing Solutions — Leon, Wakulla, Gadsden, Jefferson, Franklin, and Liberty counties; Rare Breed Roofing — Tallahassee, Florida and surrounding areas; Arnold's Roofing Enterprises — Tallahassee.
- Stated time in business: Smith family, 43 years in the Tallahassee roofing industry (as stated on the company site); Arnold's Roofing Enterprises since fall 1995; Hartsfield since 2008; Coastal Roofing Solutions since November 2020.
- Stated services: Smith lists residential and commercial roofing and re-roofing, emergency repairs, and a free estimate. Hartsfield lists residential and commercial installations, repairs, and replacements, and 24/7 emergency roof repairs. Coastal lists shingle and metal roof replacement and repair, and free roof inspections. Rare Breed lists premium roof replacement. Arnold's lists residential and commercial roofing, re-roofing, and repairs, metal and shingle, roof maintenance (debris removal, cleaning, inspection, and gutters), and a free estimate. Listed certifications: CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster (Smith); Owens Corning Preferred Contractor (Coastal and Rare Breed).

## Things to know before you go

Open the linked DBPR page for the license you are considering. Coastal Roofing Solutions lists Kayleigh Marie Kellogg as qualifier. Named owners are Troy Smith, Rett Hartsfield, Shawn Kellogg, Jena Tadlock Enfinger and Michael Enfinger, and Terry B. Arnold, Sr.

Confirm your address is inside the stated service area before you schedule. A website is listed for each company.

Prices are unknown for every contractor here, so ask for an estimate. A free estimate is stated for Smith Roofing and Repair and for Arnold's Roofing Enterprises. Coastal Roofing Solutions states free roof inspections. Hartsfield lists Monday–Friday 8:00 am–5:00 pm, Saturday and Sunday emergency services, and 24/7 emergency roof repairs. Coastal lists Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–6:00 PM. Smith lists emergency repairs.

Where a warranty is stated: Hartsfield lists a 25-year lifetime manufacturer's warranty and a five- to 10-year labor warranty available, plus financing through First Commerce Credit Union (Commerce Connect). Coastal lists a 10-year workmanship warranty on residential reroofs and a 5-year warranty on commercial and flat roofs. Arnold's lists a company workmanship warranty (term not stated) plus manufacturer warranties of 30-year to lifetime offered by most materials manufacturers. Arnold's is also listed as a certified minority-owned business with the Tallahassee-Leon County Office of Economic Vitality.

## FAQ

### Are these contractors licensed with the Florida DBPR?

Yes. Each is a Certified Roofing Contractor with status Current, Active in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup, and each license expires 08/31/2028. License numbers are listed above, and each listing links to its DBPR source.

### Do they serve the same area?

No. Coastal Roofing Solutions states Leon, Wakulla, Gadsden, Jefferson, Franklin, and Liberty counties. Hartsfield states Tallahassee, Bradfordville, Crawfordville, and surrounding North Florida. Smith Roofing and Repair states Tallahassee and north Florida. Rare Breed Roofing states Tallahassee, Florida and surrounding areas. Arnold's Roofing Enterprises states Tallahassee.

### What is stated about estimates, emergency service, and warranties?

Prices are unknown, so ask for an estimate. Smith states a free estimate and emergency repairs. Hartsfield states 24/7 emergency roof repairs and Saturday and Sunday emergency services. Coastal states free roof inspections and Monday–Friday hours of 8:00 AM–6:00 PM. Where a warranty or financing offer is stated above, ask which terms apply to your job.
